## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated at the right level (docs/06-testing-strategy.md §3)
- [ ] Docs or ADR updated if behaviour, parameters or decisions changed
- [ ] No new compiler or analyzer warnings
- [ ] Screenshots for UI changes; keyboard-operable and checked in two browsers
- [ ] `data-policy` label and reasoning, if this changes what is built, packaged or published
- [ ] No real-race bundles or packages, and no raw OpenF1 responses beyond trimmed fixtures (ADR-0008)
